app_identity.name: EtherLens AI
app_identity.tagline: Next-Generation Intelligent Network Traffic Analysis & Packet Decryption Platform
app_identity.theme_mode: Clean SaaS Light (Default) + Tactical Dark Mode toggle

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: MODE B: High Density Dashboard Grid
layout_and_spacing.containers: px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 max-w-[1700px] mx-auto
rules: No full-screen dark gradients without crisp sub-borders.
Containers with borders must maintain inner padding (minimum p-4) to prevent collision.

Dropdowns, popovers, and sticky sub-headers MUST have explicit semi-opaque or solid backgrounds with backdrop blur (e.g., bg-white/95 dark:bg-slate-900/95 backdrop-blur-md). NEVER pure transparent backgrounds.

features: Interface selector dropdown (eth0, wlan0, lo, All Interfaces)
Live Capture Start/Stop/Pause toggle button with animated pulsing pulse dot
Display Filter Input bar with BPF & keyword auto-complete (e.g., 'ip.addr == 192.168.1.1 and tcp.port == 80')

panes.name: Pane 1: Real-time Packet Virtual Table
panes.details: Displays Packet No., Time, Source IP, Source Port, Dest IP, Dest Port, Protocol, Length, Info Summary, Threat Tag. Supports click to inspect, colored row badges per protocol.

panes.name: Pane 2: Packet Layered Protocol Tree
panes.details: Expandable tree structure breakdown: Frame -> Ethernet II -> IPv4/IPv6 -> TCP/UDP/ICMP/QUIC -> Application Data (HTTP, TLS, DNS, MQTT).

panes.name: Pane 3: Dual Hex & ASCII Dump View
panes.details: Monospace hex bytes alignment (16 bytes per line) with offset counter and corresponding ASCII string panel on right, with hover byte sync highlight.

widgets: Real-time Bandwidth Line/Area Chart (Bits/sec and Packets/sec over time using Recharts)
Protocol Distribution Donut Chart (TCP vs UDP vs ICMP vs DNS vs HTTP/TLS)
Top Talkers / Active Flows Table with bandwidth consumption bars

features: Interactive SVG/Canvas Force-Directed Host Node Graph
Visualizes Gateway, Local Hosts, External IPs, Servers with real-time particle packet flow animation on edges
Node click opens host detail modal (Host OS estimate, Open ports, Traffic volume, Associated threats)
Real-time anomaly detector feed (Port Scans, SYN Floods, DNS Tunneling, Suspicious TLS SNI, Unencrypted Password Transmits)
AI Explanation Drawer / Modal: 'Explain This Packet in Plain English' powered by backend anomaly classifier
Severity filter pills (Critical, High, Medium, Info)

micro_interactions: Packet stream hover highlight with smooth text color contrast
Live pulsing dot indicator for active packet sniffing (emerald glowing ring animation)
Expandable protocol tree chevron rotation transition (0.15s ease-out)
motion_and_effects.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion, disable complex edge animations when requested by OS settings.

testing_attributes.rule: Every interactive button, input, tab, table row, filter, and modal container MUST have data-testid in kebab-case format.

curated_image_assets.description: Server rack network cables for empty state wallpaper or login panel
curated_image_assets.usage: Use in PCAP upload empty states or landing backdrop
Hero banner for offline PCAP drop zone

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete, responsive, real-time packet monitoring SaaS tool called EtherLens AI.
Ensure all components use React .jsx format, matching existing Shadcn primitives in src/components/ui/.
Support full live packet capture streaming mode with simulated socket fallback + real backend REST/WebSocket endpoints.
Provide accurate Wireshark-like packet dissector visualization (Frame, Ethernet, IPv4/IPv6, TCP/UDP/ICMP/DNS/HTTP/TLS) with hex dump pane.
Provide plain-English AI Packet Explanations with risk score and anomaly flags.
Include a dynamic Topology Map and Flow Conversation Graph.
Ensure both Light theme and Dark theme look impeccably crisp, highly legible with proper APCA high contrast text.
Attach data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
